lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Hunter-Captain is down. His soldiers scatter into the alleys, and the town shuts its doors.

lines.speaker: needles
lines.text: Be gone before they count the bodies. I know a way out on the salt barges.

lines.speaker: needles
lines.text: Somebody has to keep your purse safe.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: That night on the barge, the others ask what the captain meant. What the sword knows.

lines.speaker: mc
lines.text: It talks to me. At night, mostly. It says there were ten, and it wants them back together.

lines.speaker: needles
lines.text: Mine says the same. I thought I was going mad.

lines.speaker: gravemaw
lines.text: Then nobody carries one of these alone. Not anymore.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nobody sleeps far from the others after that.

lines.speaker: mc
lines.text: Nothing worth repeating. Old steel and old grudges.

lines.speaker: mc
lines.text: Then let me be a bad liar a while longer.

lines.speaker: blade
lines.text: Wise. They would only be afraid of you.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Downriver, the barge slides past the last of the {empire}'s banners.
